content: MISA AMIS Cham Cong and TanCa (leading VN attendance vendors) support multi-mode check-in: fingerprint, card, face recognition, GPS. Both let managers require a live selfie photo at check-in as an anti-fraud measure; TanCa also offers AI camera kiosks at entry/exit for fully automated check-in. Auto-calculation of work hours, OT, and leave from attendance data is standard.
